title: Attacker material in the gpg slot under the honest manifest -> KEY_MISMATCH (gpg)

source.model: S-P2 Q4 companion (slot B unbound), degraded
S-P2 d8 strict Q4 mutation (unregistered diagnostic)
S-P2 d11 frame fp unbound, no slot match (unregistered diagnostic)

scenario: The attacker's key in slot gpg, with its own frame fingerprint, signature and possession over the honest manifest.

mutations.with: attacker key: keys.gpg, F_gpg signer.key_fp, S_gpg, possession.gpg

test_universe.hooks: attacker gpg key for slot material; manifest built for the honest gpg key; adversarial=True

needs: A real receipt plus an attacker OpenPGP P-256 key; re-encode a_sig.

subcases.title: TEST form: re-stamped
subcases.construction: TEST issue, adversarial; gpg slot material (keys.gpg, F_gpg signer.key_fp, S_gpg, possession.gpg) from attacker key e10-attacker-gpg; manifest names the honest gpg key; DNS names the honest keys; A_sig stamped
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)

subcases.title: L0/L1 form: not re-stamped
subcases.construction: A-a; post-issue: keys.gpg, possession.gpg and the a_sig gpg pair replaced by the attacker material of .restamped; receipt_anchor kept (the L0/L1 form)
subcases.T_derivation: T null: a_sig changed after stamping, so the receipt proof's digest no longer matches (row 11.2); U null with T (A10.1.1)
